summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only verification for MJ launcher stability, mobile positioning, bubble placement, and Pricing/Packages removal. All 9 review-request items PASS. Mobile launcher center is exactly at 633px (75% of 844px viewport, target ±40) and remained byte-identical across 5 captures spanning 2 bubble show/hide cycles + scroll + panel open/close. Mobile bubble renders BELOW icon (y=675 > icon bottom 665), stays within viewport (right=295 < 391). Desktop bubble renders ABOVE icon (bottom=700 < icon top 712) with launcher at bottom-left (24,712). Pricing section fully removed (no 'Choose Your Package', no ₹1,999/₹4,999/₹9,999 markers, no pricing nav/footer links). Section order confirmed: Hero → Brands → Services → Recent Projects → Trusted Brands → Founders → FAQ. Cert verification via MJ chatbot ('VERIFY MR00-XX-00000') still returns cert-card-verified. Book a call widget still present. No horizontal overflow at 390 or 1280.
critical_code_review_comments: Two elements share data-testid='mj-suggestion-bubble' simultaneously during AnimatePresence enter/exit (old bubble exiting while new bubble entering). Only visual impact is that Playwright strict-mode selectors trip; icon stability is not affected. Recommend making the testid unique per bubble instance or using a single wrapper testid to keep test selectors reliable.
Footer contains nested <a> hydration warning (pre-existing, flagged as ignorable in review request but worth fixing: an outer <a> wraps another <a> in the Footer services list).
/verify route returns 404 (verification is intended via MJ chatbot only). If a direct /verify page is not planned, consider removing any residual references; if planned, add route.
